description: Create a new operator-owned discount coupon.

name.description:
The catchy code patrons type to redeem
(operator-scoped uniqueness).

total_uses.description:
Aggregate cap across all patrons (default None =
unlimited).

uses_per_patron.description:
How many tool calls one patron can claim the
discount on (default 1; pass null/None for unlimited
within the window).

valid_from.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the coupon becomes active.

valid_until.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the coupon expires.
